posts.subject: [ENG] Forum Ranks 15/09/2017
posts.bodyHtml:
User Available Ranks


[Bild]
For the rank "Stamm User" you have to achieve 300 forum points.
( Points only granted for forum activity )


[Bild]
For the rank "Stamm User 2" you have to achieve 600 forum points.


[Bild]
For the rank "Stamm User 3" you have to achieve 1000 forum points.


[Bild]
For the rank "Stamm User 4" you have to achieve 2600 forum points.


[Bild]
For the rank "VIP User" you have to achieve 4000 forum points.


[Bild]
For the rank "Final VIP + Star" you have to achieve 6666 forum points.


[Bild]
For the rank "Senior Member + Glitter" you have to achieve 10000 forum points.


[Bild]
For the rank "Donator" donation of 5€ is required.


[Bild]
For the rank "Donator +" donation of 50€ is required.


[Bild]
For the rank "Donator ♥" donation of 100€ is required.


Team Available Ranks


[Bild]
As a designer you're in charge of creating: Graphics/ logos/ pictures for the community.
Example when a user wants a avatar then Designer is in charge of this.


[Bild]
As a Mapper you're in charge of creating good unique maps for the community.


[Bild]
As a Coder you create and script plugins for the Dream Community.
This person has to understand computer language such as C++, Pawnscript, PHP and other, to get this position you have to turn to Co-Leader or higher in out TeamSpeak3 server and gift your work to the community for free as help to support.


[Bild]
The rank donator is awarded to people who have made donation of at least 3€ to support Dream.
Automatically successful donation will grand you this header.


[Bild]
Sponsor is not awarded to people who only donate 1x 5€.
The sponsor pays the community monthly cost/ whole cost of the servers.


[Bild]
As a Forum Moderator you're in charge of keeping the forum clear.
Contribute in the forum by closing topics, if behavior goes to far then by warning certain user.
When topic goes too far or it's a normal discussion.
For this position understanding of user is required and resistance.


[Bild]
If your application gets accepted then you become a Supporter
Responsibilities of Supporter are as following:
- Support the players on the server
- Support the (Test-)Administrators
Focus of the Supporter: maintaining the rules on the server


[Bild]
If your application gets accepted or you are contacted by us as an Supporter then you become Test-Administrator.
Responsibilities of Test-Administrator are as following:
- Administrate the server
- General Activity in the community
- Prove your suitability for the position
- Contact person for users
Focus of the Test-Administrator: Support


[Bild]
If you pass your Test-Administrator time then a higher position is available for you.
Test-Admin time length depends on a person or how they do, there is no set time when this position comes to you.
Responsibilities of Administrator are as following:
- Administrate the servers
- For user/ Test-Admin as contact person
- Respond to questions form users/ Test-Admins
- Show correct behavior, serve as Role-Model
- Know the server rules well
- Exchange ideas with other Admin members
- Answer Complaints
Focus of the Administrator: Integration, know more areas of community


[Bild]
If you do more than previous Administrator rank then your uprank is possible.
As you can do more then more will come to you, check what is possible for you to do to increase your chance to get this position.
Of course not everyone is available to get this position.
Don't see the uprank as something self-evident, but more than just activity is required for this position.
Responsibilities of Administrator + are as following:
- Administrate the servers
- For User/ Test-Admin/ Admin as contact person
- Comment on applications
- Higher activity on our TeamSpeak3 server
- Find and solve problems in the community
- Creating and forwarding suggestions
- Daily activity on forum ( You don't have to post something but just check out the forum )
- Administrating the forum
Focus of the Administrator +: Activity, Solution orientated thinking


[Bild]
You're more than active as Administrator +, you're suitable for this position, and could convince us?
Then it's possible for you to go one rank higher, Super-Administrator starts for you the full support for the community.
Only few people managed to achieve this rank.
Responsibilities of Super-Administrator are as following:
- All tasks of Administrator +
- Increasing the population of community
- Create concepts and expanding the community more
- DREAM TEAM ~ Tag is MANDATORY
- Respond to complaints about administrators
- Activity on TeamSpeak3 is MANDATORY
- Identify possible risks for the community
Focus of the Super-Administrator: Expansion of the community, Serving as contact person


[Bild]
The community is a big part for you.
You would like to continue the Administrative position and a gladly a contact person.
You enjoy supporting the community and fill out the tasks of Super-Administrator and have meet our Long term requirements.
Your TeamSpeak3 activity is more than above average and the loyalty stands out incredibly.
Then it's more than possible for you to achieve the next step which is Head-Administrator.
Responsibilities of Head-Administrator are as following:
- All tasks of Super-Administrator
- Assign Administrators ( right allocation, initiation, End calls )
- Serve as a contact person for lower ranks
- Great commitment and ensuring the user is satisfied of the outcome
- Bring in your own ideas and take care of the community
- Solve all the possible problems that arise without and problem
- Check all the servers and find the possible fix
- Ensure the community has a right atmosphere and users are comfortable here
Focus of the Head-Administrator: Answering applications, satisfying users, enlarging the community


[Bild]
If you have been working hard as Head-Administrator for a very long time and have also gained a total trust including great suitability to become a Co-Leader.
However a great deal must be done and the person must be made suitable for this position.
As a Co-Leader you have to show ONLY the highest level as you gain a lot of responsibilities as you get limited access to SSH, understanding of Linux is required, Server Management and SSH knowledge is a advantage.
Responsibilities of Co-Leader are as following:
- All tasks of Head-Administrator
- Servers are waiting for Putty/ Filezilla
- Find and fix server errors
- Collect solutions ( Example add maps or plugins for suitable server )
- Server as a contact person for lower ranks
- Bring innovation to the community
- Full forum administration
- Contribution to the rules
Focus of the Co-Leader: Server maintenance, higher community expansion


[Bild]
As a leader you have not created the community but work closely with the owner.
For this rank very much is needed, too much to name.
A leader is not only for community, or activity, but shows the permanent commitment and does everything to make the community a better place, It's the highest leadership position.
Responsibilities of Leader are as following:
- All tasks of Co-Leader
- Contact person for any rank in the community
- Setting up servers ( Full SSH access )
- Thinking more, Creating more projects
- Thinking in how to maximize the community members
Focus of the Leader: Everything


[Bild]
There is only one owner.
The owner is a person that has made the community from ashes.
The owner is the boss, he created you and intended to run something as big, gives you the guide on how the community shall be ran.
Dream was created in 20.02.2012 by Sky (SkyK1ll)


To become Supporter you have to be 15 years old.


To become Test-Administrator, Administrator or Administrator + you have to be 16 years old.


To become Super-Administrator, Head-Administrator, Co-Leader, Leader you have to be 18 years old.

Support 1 csgo/css Server = Supporter



Administrate 1 csgo/css Server = Test-Admin


Administrate 2 csgo/css Servers = Administrator



Administrate 4 csgo Servers (+css) = Administrator +



Administrate ALL csgo & css Servers = Super Administrator



Administrate ALL Servers = Head-Administrator



Administrate ALL Servers + Limited Server Access = Co-Leader



Administrate ALL Servers + Full Server Access = Leader




Founder of the Community = Owner
